title: Account registration
intro: Manage how new accounts can be created on this MovieMux instance.
unavailable: Registration settings could not be verified. Refresh to check access again.
modeHint: Changing the mode affects future registrations for the entire instance. Pending waitlist requests are preserved.
confirmModeMessage: Set registration for this instance to {mode}? Existing accounts and pending waitlist requests will be preserved.
modeUnconfirmed: The mode change could not be confirmed. Refresh to check the current mode before making another change.
waitlistHint: Review individual requests. Sending an invitation uses the email address supplied by the requester. Acceptance by the email gateway is not proof of delivery.
confirmInvite: Issue an invitation to {email}? If an earlier submission outcome is unknown, another email could be sent.
confirmRetry: Retry sending the existing invitation to {email}? A previous attempt may already have reached the recipient.
confirmUnknown: The earlier email submission may have succeeded. Retrying the existing invitation for {email} could send a duplicate email. Continue?
confirmRetrieve: Retrieve the existing invitation code for {email}? This does not send another email.
inviteUnconfirmed: The invitation outcome could not be confirmed. Refresh the requests before taking another action. Do not assume the email was not sent.
copyHint: Copy the existing code if you need to share it manually. Keep it private.
copyFailed: Automatic copying failed. Select and copy the code manually.
empty: No waitlist requests on this page.
